step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identify Visual Nodes: The whiteboard displays a customer VPC containing EC2 (with agent) and CloudTrail. Data flows to a Kafka ingestion stream. From Kafka, traffic splits into two main paths:
   a) Near Real Time: Kafka -> Apache Flink -> S3 bucket (GZIP/JSON format).
   b) Long Term / Data Lake: Kafka -> EMR cluster -> S3 bucket (Parquet format).
   c) Orchestration: An EC2 instance (labeled 'Orch' / '30 Days') orchestrates and spins up EMR clusters (the main processing EMR cluster and the consumption EMR cluster).
   d) Consumption Layer: S3 Parquet bucket connects to Athena, SageMaker, and a secondary consumption EMR cluster.

2. Service Mapping:
   - EC2: EC2 (Customer EC2 and Orchestration EC2)
   - CloudTrail: CloudTrail
   - Kafka: ThirdParty
   - Apache Flink: ThirdParty
   - S3: S3 (Near Real-Time S3 & Data Warehouse S3)
   - EMR: EMR (Processing EMR & Consumption EMR)
   - Athena: Athena
   - SageMaker: SageMaker

3. Tracing Connections & Flow Sequences:
   - Flow 0 (Real-Time Path): EC2 & CloudTrail -> Kafka -> Flink -> S3 (NRT)
   - Flow 1 (Batch/Analytics Path): Kafka -> EMR (Processing) -> S3 (Data Lake) -> Athena / SageMaker / EMR (Consumption)
   - Orchestration control triggers from EC2 Orchestrator to EMR clusters.

nodes.name: EMR Consumption Cluster

edges.notes: Agent sends telemetry over the internet to Kafka
Kafka feeds Apache Flink for real-time path
Flink writes GZIPed JSON to NRT S3 bucket
EMR writes Parquet formatted files to S3
Athena queries Parquet data directly from S3
SageMaker trains ML models using S3 data
Consumption EMR cluster reads Parquet data from S3
Orchestration service manages consumption EMR cluster
